{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to only completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
cleaned_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute total revenue by channel
channel_revenue = cleaned_orders.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Sort by revenue to find the highest
channel_revenue_sorted = channel_revenue.sort_values('revenue', ascending=False)

# Print the result
channel_revenue_sorted"}
